name: generated-project
on: [push, pull_request]
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '24'
      - run: npm test

# {{name}}

A deterministic Dynamo project. Run `npm test`. Source is generated without executing hooks or downloading code. Review before deployment.

export function sum(values) { if (!Array.isArray(values) || values.length > 10000 || values.some(v => typeof v !== "number" || !Number.isFinite(v))) throw Error("Invalid values"); const result = values.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0); if(!Number.isFinite(result)) throw Error("Overflow"); return result; }
import test from "node:test"; import assert from "node:assert/strict"; import {sum} from "./index.mjs"; test("sum",()=>assert.equal(sum([1,2]),3)); test("invalid",()=>assert.throws(()=>sum([NaN])));
